purpose: Deterministically separate structural market liquidity risk from executable-book availability, quote freshness, personnel uncertainty and sharp-benchmark availability when constructing Core 1.4 context.

principles.structuralNotAvailability: liquidityRisk describes the underlying competition/market structure. It is not a count of currently fresh Bet365/DraftKings quotes.
principles.rule: Do not label a mainstream primary game market THIN merely because only one execution book is currently usable, the other execution book is absent/stale, Pinnacle is unavailable, or personnel is unresolved. Those conditions have their own Core/publication treatment.

deterministicRules.reason: A standard pregame MLB full-game moneyline is a mainstream primary market, not a structurally thin competition or derivative.
A standard pregame MLB full-game run line/spread is a mainstream primary market.
A standard pregame MLB full-game total is a mainstream primary market.

thinEvidence.required: THIN requires affirmative structural evidence that the competition or exact market is meaningfully less liquid/robust than a mainstream primary market.
validExamples: documented sparse market-making or materially restricted market depth
invalidExamples: one execution book unavailable or stale
unresolved lineup, starter, role or bullpen information

outsideDeterministicScope.rule: For markets not covered by a deterministic rule, classify from explicit market-structure evidence. Use UNKNOWN when structural liquidity cannot be responsibly established; never infer THIN solely from quote availability.

historyPolicy.rule: This policy governs candidates produced after activation. Earlier issued reports are not rewritten solely to change a liquidityRisk label.
